citations.quote: Your Clients will Respect you MORE if...

observation.text: The expression begins with an ellipsis after the first phrase to create anticipation.

citations.quote: Guys, do you know that the dentists, and I checked it with them with several, they don't actually have all of these book appointments, but they force you to come two p.m. on Thursday. Do you know why?

observation.text: The speaker repeats 'do you know' to emphasize the message and engages the audience with a rhetorical question.

citations.quote: they don't actually have all of these book appointments, but they force you to come two p.m. on Thursday.

observation.text: The speaker uses dentists as a hypothetical example to illustrate how authority can influence relationships.
